opening: good. I was getting far too comfortable.
note: Decisions 80 and 86, and the Thriller and Crime build's decision 3: the door runs on the model labels (the labels file, data/labels.json). One question, its kinds, then "anything". A film sits under every kind it is labelled with; a film labelled behind the door with no kind, or not yet labelled, is reached through "anything" and "Just pick one!". The spies reply self-destructs, and no other answer may. A kind under 30 films in the library is not offered (erotic, in the operator's library).

questions.ask: so, what kind of trouble are we in?

options.say: whodunits and conspiracies. give me a mystery that needs working out.
options.reply: splendid. trust no one. including me.

options.say: trapped, hunted, or held hostage. no way out.
options.reply: lovely. I'll lock the door behind you.

options.say: mind games, manipulation, and misdirection. don't let me see it coming.
options.reply: good. let's see who gets inside whose head.

options.say: spies, secret agents, and international intrigue. give me the briefing.
options.reply: your assignment is classified. this message will self-destruct in five seconds.

options.say: serial killers. the hunt, or the mind behind it.
options.reply: careful. you may just forget which side of the glass you're on...

options.say: erotic thrillers. desire is the dangerous part.
options.reply: I'll be in the other room.

options.say: anything. just keep me on the edge of my seat.
options.reply: very well. no relaxing until the credits.

keep_guessing.note: mysteries, whodunits and conspiracies; the pleasure is working it out (Gone Girl, The Prestige, Zodiac).

trapped.note: trapped, hunted or held hostage; a few people against a threat with no way out (Room, Die Hard, Gravity).

mind_games.note: a battle of minds: manipulation, cat and mouse, deliberate misdirection, psychological warfare and unreliable minds (Fight Club, Memento, Se7en).

spies.note: secret agents and espionage; shared with the action door's spies.

serial_killers.note: the hunt for, or the mind of, a serial killer; shared with the crime door, so a film behind both doors holds it at both or neither.

erotic.note: erotic thrillers; desire is the danger (Basic Instinct, Body Heat). Under the 30-film bar in the operator's library, so hidden there.
